d:
Dive into Delta Lake's Change Data Feed (CDF) with Render Kumar as he explains what CDF is, how it works under the hood, and demonstrates it step‑by‑step in Databricks. You'll see how to enable CDF, explore the internal storage layout, run inserts, updates, and deletes, and read the change feed using Spark. The video also covers practical use cases like incremental loads, downstream processing, and handling deletes, plus tips on when to enable or disable CDF to avoid unnecessary overhead.
What you will learn:
• The concept and purpose of Change Data Feed in Delta Lake
